purpose: Compile the proven AZURMENTON-005 guide publication path into a deterministic local-first playbook for ready author text plus ready cover to published multilingual guide.

required_inputs.name: guide_slug
required_inputs.description: Target guide slug already approved for publication.

required_inputs.name: author_text_ready
required_inputs.description: Human-authored source text already prepared for publication.

required_inputs.name: publication_languages
required_inputs.description: Localized publication languages prepared for insertion.

deterministic_steps.description: Create the intake scaffold from the approved source text and cover.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: validated intake folder and publication scaffold

deterministic_steps.description: Copy approved cover assets and derive public image outputs.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: cover image copied into public/images/guide and derivatives added

deterministic_steps.description: Run the narrow guide readiness checks before manual insertion.
deterministic_steps.command: npm run content:lint && npm run guides:verify -- --pilot
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: guide content and provenance checks pass without broad repository reasoning

deterministic_steps.description: Record a compact CONTENT_PUBLISHED event and routine evidence without portfolio mutation.

STANDARD: project registry path and repo match
FULL: broad content lint and type/lint/build suite
human review of factual conflicts and localization exceptions
CRITICAL: security or infrastructure review with explicit approval gate

expected_outputs: published multilingual guide content in AzurMenton
allowed_changes: guide cover assets and derivative manifest
provenance sidecar for the published guide
compact event and evidence files in ABVX-OS
prohibited_changes: portfolio state mutation from routine success
escalation_conditions: unexpected structural mismatch in AzurMenton content model
